llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must call `requestPermission` from `useCameraPermissions()` only from a user-triggered action (for example `Pressable.onPress`), not on initial mount.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: requestPermission is called only inside handleRequestPermission and handleRetryPermission, both wired to Pressable.onPress handlers, never on mount.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must support denied and blocked flows by retrying with `requestPermission` and using `Linking.openSettings()` when `permission.canAskAgain` is false.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The 'limited' state (canAskAgain=false) calls handleOpenSettings which only shows an Alert with an empty onPress stub `() => {}` instead of calling Linking.openSettings(). handleOpenSettingsIOS/Android with Linking.openSettings() are defined but never called.
evidence: const handleOpenSettingsIOS = () => { const Linking = require('react-native').Linking; Linking.openSettings() } // never called

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must refresh permission state on app foreground with `AppState.addEventListener('change', ...)` and a permission refresh call (`getPermission` / `getCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No AppState.addEventListener('change', ...) is used. The second useEffect uses Camera.addCameraPermissionsListener which is not an AppState-based foreground refresh and is not a standard expo-camera API for permission refresh on app foreground.
evidence: No AppState import or usage anywhere in the file

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render a deterministic fallback `View`/`Text` path when permission is unavailable instead of rendering `CameraView`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When permission is not granted, renderPermissionScreen returns a View/Text fallback for undetermined, denied, and limited states. The camera is never rendered without granted state.
evidence: renderPermissionScreen returns View+Text nodes for all non-granted states

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must prevent concurrent permission requests by guarding `requestPermission` with an in-flight state (for example `requesting`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No in-flight/requesting guard state exists. Multiple rapid presses on the permission buttons would trigger concurrent requestPermission calls.
evidence: const handleRequestPermission = async () => { const result = await requestPermission() ... }
No 'requesting' or loading state variable declared

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render `CameraView` only when `permission.granted` is true, with deterministic denied/blocked fallback UI otherwise.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Camera (CameraView equivalent) is rendered only when permissionState === 'granted' and isForeground is true; all other states render fallback UI.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement preview with `CameraView` and permission handling with `expo-camera` APIs used by the sample (`useCameraPermissions` with request/get methods, or `getCameraPermissionsAsync`/`requestCameraPermissionsAsync`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses the legacy Camera component and CameraType from 'expo-camera' instead of the modern CameraView API. The package.json also does not list expo-camera as a dependency.
evidence: package.json has no 'expo-camera' entry in dependencies
